responsibility: This header declares the common interfaces and data structures exported by gensupport.cc to the various generator programs. It defines md_rtx_info, optab and optab_pattern metadata, predicate records, pattern_stats, and the shared APIs for initializing .md readers, reading define_* RTL, querying C tests, computing pattern statistics, locating file positions, choosing emit helpers, and matching instruction names to optab patterns.
same_name_distinction: Public header for the gen* support layer: it declares md_rtx_info, optab and predicate-related types, pattern_stats, and the APIs exported from gcc/gensupport.cc. Unlike gcc/gensupport.cc, it is the interface contract consumed by generator programs rather than the implementation of .md transformation and analysis logic.
